note: The stick has a throttle + brake lever pair on EACH side (ambidextrous). The catalog has one throttle and one brake part; they are placed on the left pair (outboard cylinder = throttle, inboard curved paddle = brake, mirrored from the labelled right pair). Which side the game/HID reports for these parts is unknown. Which button is the "High-G button" is not stated by HORI; the yellow striped button in the middle of the head is only a hidden candidate. The red "CAUTION" button carries the PlayStation circle symbol, the two dark buttons square and triangle.
